summary: User enumeration via timing in OpenSSH before 7.3.
Privilege escalation via supplemental groups in sshd.
recommended_action: Patch sshd and restrict AuthorizedKeysCommand privileges.

summary: Privilege escalation in web server worker processes.
recommended_action: Update to the latest stable web server release.

summary: Ghostcat: AJP request injection / file read & include in Apache Tomcat.
recommended_action: Upgrade Tomcat and disable the AJP connector if unused.

summary: Improper signature verification allowing authentication bypass.
recommended_action: Apply the latest Tomcat security patches.

summary: Remote code execution / privilege escalation via malicious config.
recommended_action: Patch MySQL and restrict FILE privileges.

summary: Stack buffer overflow in PostgreSQL via crafted SCRAM messages.
recommended_action: Upgrade PostgreSQL to a patched minor release.
